name: Cerro Provincia over Santiago
region: Parque Puente Ñilhue, Lo Barnechea, Santiago
why: The big day hike from Santiago: 1,800 m of dry ridge from the Mapocho gorge to a summit with the whole city on one side and the high Andes on the other.
book: Named ticket bought in advance at Puntoticket (Parque Puente Ñilhue). The park opens weekends and holidays, 08:00-19:00 in summer and 08:00-18:00 in winter; last entry for trekking 13:00. The trailhead is at Puente Ñilhue on the road to Farellones.
water: The last water is an irrigation canal at about km 2 (1,470 m): carry 3 litres or more.
dangers: Heat and sun with no shade on the long ridge in summer.
Snow and unstable weather in winter.
A short rocky pass with about 3 m of scrambling below the summit.
turnaround: Not at the rocky pass by 14:00: turn back, the descent takes 3 hours.

points.name: Puente Ñilhue trailhead
points.note: The park entrance by the old bridge over the Mapocho, at about 1,000 m. The path climbs south up the dry slope.

points.name: Alto del Naranjo
points.note: 1,890 m, about 3.7 km in: the first wide view of Santiago. The ridge to the summit starts here.

points.name: Cerro Provincia summit
points.note: 2,750 m, with a small dome refuge just east of the top. Santiago on one side, the high Andes on the other. Return the same way.
